scope: basic automated release-candidate interaction smoke; not comprehensive profiling
actionsObserved: starting, pausing, resuming, extending and skipping the rest timer
limitations: XCUITest activity duration includes deliberate waits, typing delays and screenshots, so total test time is not an interaction latency benchmark.
No Instruments allocation trace or React commit profile was captured in this release gate.
This evidence rejects obvious native interaction regressions only; it does not certify long-lived-account performance or absence of memory leaks.
